subject.title: feat(ui): camera picker and live flip for realtime Talk

question: Should Control UI persist a gateway-scoped, browser-local realtime Talk camera selection and expose a live in-call camera-flip control as part of the supported Talk experience?
rationale: The patch adds a new user-facing capability and persisted setting rather than repairing an established broken contract; code review cannot determine whether that product surface should be permanent.

options.title: Sponsor the camera controls
options.body: Accept the client-local persisted preference and require real browser hardware proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to camera selection
options.body: Keep the Settings picker but defer the live in-call flip control until its runtime behavior is separately validated.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause this product addition until maintainer direction establishes the desired realtime Talk video-control surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the camera controls
recommendation.body: Accept the client-local persisted preference and require real browser hardware proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: A current-main feature-history owner could not be identified from the supplied review context alone.
